description: Pokemon Snap playthroughs for kiosk attract mode. Used by SnapCapture.YouTubeFrameSource. Replace with your own curated list; the kiosk randomly selects one on idle timeout.
notes: When playthroughs is empty the kiosk attract screen falls back to its built-in CSS demo reel. Do not ship copyrighted playthroughs in production kiosks without licensing. For in-store Blockbuster nostalgia, use self-recorded emulator footage of the NPFE ROM with the CRT overlay on; the emulator window is captured via SnapCapture.DisplayFrameSource, which also works for live demos.

example_entry.title: Replace with licensed / self-recorded footage, then move into playthroughs
